description: This file defines the ControlEnvProxyServer class, which implements the CommandSource interface to provide commands for controlling environment proxy server via gRPC socket. It also includes dependency injection setup for the component.

classes.name: ControlEnvProxyServer
classes.description: Implements CommandSource to provide commands for control environment proxy server, utilizing gRPC socket creation and configuration dependencies.
